name: Rock N' Summer Fun Camp
description_short: A 7-week town-run half-day summer program for Salem residents ages 6 to 10, held at Barron Elementary School from 9:00AM to 12:30PM, five days a week. It has themed weeks, games, arts & crafts, and a field trip once a week.

warnings: Old season: no year is given, but June 19 is a Monday in 2023 and the linked registration form is named 'summer_fun_2023_cd.pdf', so the dates appear to be for 2023, not the upcoming 2027 season.
The page says 'This program is unavailable.' This program listing is no longer active.
The page says 'The costs listed below reflect the total amount for the 7-week camp', but no prices appear in the text.
Only Salem, NH residents can attend: 'No Non-residents or Massachusetts residents at this time.'
The camp runs at Barron Elementary School. The address, city and zip recorded here belong to the Community Services Department office (1 Sally Sweets Way), not the camp site.
Before/after care is run by Create & Discover. It has separate fees paid directly to them, and your child must be registered for the camp first.
